instructions.primary_message: This recipe contains steps that can be done by smaller hands! You know your child (and their cooking abilities) best, so get them involved where you feel comfortable. Have fun!

Take one baby carrot and trim lengthwise on three sides, creating a long triangle shape. Thinly slice the triangle crosswise to create 12 bunny "noses." Thinly slice remaining baby carrots lengthwise to create the bunny "ears." Place both on a plate.
Wash and dry celery. Slice lengthwise into very thin matchsticks, then cut matchsticks crosswise into ¾-inch long bunny "whiskers." Add to the plate with the carrots.
Cut drained olives into small pieces for bunny "eyes." Add to the plate.
Unwrap cheese rounds, then carefully cut a 1 ½-inch slit along the rounded edge, to create a place to easily insert the ears. Add to the plate.

To decorate a bunny face, insert ears into the opening at the top of the cheese round (trim ears shorter if you prefer). Put a dot of mayo in the center of each face and use this to help attach the whiskers and nose. Finally, add 2 eyes. Repeat with remaining ingredients, using your creativity to make unique faces as desired!
Arrange cheese bunnies on a platter, share, and enjoy!
